claim_scope.VdB_Rains: Conditional on matching the initial heart, blow-up centers, gluing bimodules, and blow-down functors. The t-exactness proof applies the known pseudo-canonical characterization.
claim_scope.Rains_anticanonical: Specified Rains gluing from a genuine smooth classical del Pezzo S and smooth anticanonical elliptic E, for q in Pic^0(E). Includes a full proof of the natural derived comparison; full-heart HRS description assumes the chosen Rains anticanonical class is nef.
claim_scope.AS_anticanonical: Conditional abelian criterion: identified folding and structure vertex, right noetherian B and pBp, and both corner bimodule finiteness conditions. Finite B/BpB is equivalent to equivalence of the natural corner functor.
claim_scope.resonance: Numerical resonance, existence of an oriented root sheaf, numerical ampleness, and AZ ampleness are distinguished. Actual negative-index roots detect failure; no converse is asserted.
not_completed: The actual mutation identification E0 = pi F throughout the AS comparison family
All-parameter AS t-exactness or unconditional equality of four hearts
Explicit original elliptic-generator coefficients in the affine A2 quotient
Relative heart equivalence, arbitrary boundary extension, or stack descent
claim_scope.prior_work: Known VdB, Rains, AOU, OU, HRS, and duality results are identified as inputs. No exhaustive novelty claim or external peer review.
